title: Days until a warmer day
summary: Each chilly day waits on a pile; when a warmer day arrives, every colder day on top finally gets its answer and leaves.
goal: For each day, count the days until a warmer one

examples.label: Rising
examples.explanation: Every day is followed by a warmer one.

examples.label: Three days
examples.explanation: The last day never sees a warmer one.

ladder.name: Look ahead from each day
ladder.idea: For each day, scan forward until a warmer day appears.

ladder.name: A pile of days still waiting
ladder.idea: Keep a pile of days still waiting, coldest on top. Each new day answers every colder day on top of the pile, then joins it.
ladder.insight: A day can only be answered by the first warmer day after it. Days still waiting are always in decreasing temperature, so a new warm day answers them from the top down.

transfer.problem: For each building in a row, find the first taller building to its right.
transfer.explanation: Same shape: next greater element. Keep a pile of buildings still waiting and answer them when a taller one arrives.

selfCheck: Stores indices on the pile, not temperatures.
Pops while the new day is strictly warmer.
Leaves 0 for days that are never answered.
Each day is pushed and popped at most once.
